lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R2-002 fixed the round-2 reviewer finding on scripts/test-in-container.ts:221: runInContainerTests previously ran only checkSkipCount on the container lane and never called the checkSuiteRan positive-evidence guard that US-R1-002 wired into the host lane. A crashed/zero-test/garbage `bun test` run inside the container has no ' N skip' line and was indistinguishable from a genuine clean 0-skip run whenever test/helpers/lane-expectations.json's lanes.container.expectedSkips happened to be 0 (it currently is 40, so today the container lane is fail-closed only by coincidence of that recorded value, exactly as the reviewer's finding described). Fix: runInContainerTests now reads lanes.container.passFloor from the same readExpectations() call, calls checkSuiteRan(output, passFloor, 'container') BEFORE the skip-count comparison (mirroring checkSkipRatchet's host-lane sequencing in scripts/check-skip-ratchet.ts), and only falls through to checkSkipCount when checkSuiteRan returns null (suite ran to completion with pass count >= passFloor). Return type of runInContainerTests.skipCheck widened from ReturnType<typeof checkSkipCount> to the shared SkipRatchetResult type (both checkSuiteRan and checkSkipCount already returned that shape). Added 3 regression tests in test/test-in-container.test.ts: (1) a crashed-run fixture (no completion tally at all) fails even with expectedSkips=0, asserting the exact defect the finding described is now closed; (2) a completion-tally-present-but-pass-below-passFloor case fails via the passFloor guard specifically; (3) a passing case with passFloor set confirms the guard doesn't false-positive on a genuine clean run. Had to also backfill 'Ran N tests across M files.' completion-tally lines into the pre-existing FIXTURE_ALL_PASS/FIXTURE_WITH_FAILURES/FIXTURE_ONLY_SKIPS fixtures (previously none of them carried it) and extend the fakeExpectations() test helper with an optional containerPassFloor param (default 0, preserving all prior test behavior) -- otherwise the new guard would have broken every pre-existing runInContainerTests test, since none of those fixtures had a completion tally line before this story. No production behavior change on scripts/check-skip-ratchet.ts itself; that file (and its own tests) were read for context only, not modified. Quality gates all green: bun run typecheck 0 errors; bun test 5734 pass / 0 fail / 12940 expect() across 341 files; bun run check:all all 16 gates green (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, skip-ratchet) -- file-size initially failed (scripts/test-in-container.ts grew 293->311, test/test-in-container.test.ts grew 439->500 measuring content.split('\n').length, matching the gate's own reported counts exactly), raised both ceilings in scripts/file-size-budget.json with a dated _ref entry naming this story + CAM-424, staged before re-running, then green. Note for the supervisor: both round-2 findings (US-R2-001 lane-expectations.json staleness, US-R2-002 this story) are now addressed; no further round-2 findings are known to be outstanding as of this handoff.
